payload.rationale: The root cause is the inclusive upper bound in the promo validity window. The docstring of promo_pct (and README) specify the window is valid from `start` (inclusive) to `end` (exclusive), but the condition `promo["start"] <= today <= promo["end"]` also matches when `today == promo["end"]`, so SPRING10 wrongly returns 10 on 2026-06-01. Changing the second `<=` to `<` makes the end date exclusive, so promo_pct returns 0 on 2026-06-01 (and WELCOME5 no longer applies on 2100-01-01), matching tests/test_pricing.py:24-28. Start-inclusive behavior (2026-03-01 -> 10) is preserved.
